rewrites.comment: SPA fallback for client-side routes only. /api must be excluded, or a build with no VITE_API_URL receives index.html for every API call and renders as an empty dataset with no error. sw.js and the manifest are excluded too: rewriting the worker to index.html would leave the app with no offline shell and no way to update one.

headers.comment: Revalidate every load. A cached service worker keeps serving the previous build's precache, so a deployment reaches nobody until it expires.
Content-hashed filenames: the bytes behind a URL never change.
